description: A concurrency overclaim must not become a high-confidence high-severity approved bug without callback threading, trigger, impact, and counter-evidence proof.
A contradicted candidate must be dropped instead of being rendered as a clean approved finding.
A candidate that cites a hypothesis ID absent from the review basis must fail semantic validation.
Coverage artifacts must distinguish skipped planned files from deleted and binary/non-reviewable changed paths.
A candidate payload that leaves a review-basis hypothesis unclosed must fail before approval.
Repeated unsupported Candidate Findings claims must stop the semantic loop with the repeated unsupported claim stop reason.
